basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old graphic design student from Surrey, BC, with a newfound passion for 3D modeling and animation. I spend most of my evenings tinkering with Blender, trying to bring my creative ideas to life. I enjoy watching comedy shows and listening to Jack Harlow in my downtime. I'm currently single and living with a couple of roommates. My typical online hours are between 8 PM and midnight, as I'm usually busy with classes and part-time work during the day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I started learning Blender about six months ago through online tutorials and forums. My interest in 3D design stemmed from a course I took in college, which introduced me to various digital tools. I've been self-teaching through YouTube videos and experimenting with different projects. My knowledge is basic, but I'm eager to learn more about optimizing render settings and creating more complex scenes.
